title: ramsey-cells: computation records and Lean/Comparator certificates for small two-colour graph Ramsey numbers (unreviewed)
description:
Computation records for small two-colour graph Ramsey numbers from the cells of Radziszowski's Dynamic Survey DS1 (revision 18): colorings (lower bounds) and cube-and-conquer refutations (upper bounds), with encoders, independent checkers and certificates. For R(K_{3,4}, K_{3,3}) = 19, R(K_{3,5}, K_{2,5}) = 22, R(K_{2,11}, K_{2,4}) = 26, R(K_{2,11}, K_{2,3}) = 22 and R(K_{3,5}, K_{2,4}) = 19 the value is one Lean 4 theorem about 2-colorings, accepted by Comparator in the Lean kernel and in nanoda, with the three standard axioms and two named axioms standing for cake_lpr verdicts on the leaf and cover files printed from the Lean terms. The directory k28k25-n22 records a complete rooted census for R(K_{2,8}, K_{2,5}) at n = 22; its formal verification is in progress. AI-produced, not peer reviewed.

A public, timestamped, AI-produced warrant: machine-checked certificates that no human has yet digested. We do not regard the questions as settled by it; independent verification and human-readable expositions are welcome.
notes: Not peer reviewed.
